text:
mara: Quick thread — planning cross-stack onramp for LangChain + gateway + marketplace listing. Need sandbox creds, a one-page playbook, perf artifacts, and joint-announce checklist.

henry: I can own the sandbox creds spec and quota defaults. Thinking per-partner JWTs via temp-creds, TTL 72h, scope-limited. Sample claim in doc: {"exp":1700000000, "scope": ["generate", "embeddings"], "project":"partner-sandbox"}

sophia: I'll draft the one-page playbook: signon, demo dataset snapshot, smoke tests, failover rules (route_by: [latency,cost]; fallback: redwood-xxl-int8). Keep it <1 page.

henry: Quota suggestion: default 60k tokens, billing flag disabled, dataset pin to s3://redwood-partner-demos/crossstack/v1.

mara: Legal wants an asset attestation PDF and embargo windows for joint press. @legal please confirm required fields.

legal: We need partner name, logo approval, embargo start/end, and contact list. Also avoid superlative claims unless validated by perf artifacts.

sophia: I'll include a short marketplace copy, screenshots checklist, integration snippet for LangChain and a minimal Terraform/Helm starter link.

mara: Ops note: include perf numbers for T4 and A10, both fp16 and int8, and an annotated trace showing fallback. Example format: Model: redwood-xxl-16k | HW: nvidia-t4 | Mode: int8 | p95: 210ms

henry: I'll prep rotation script and sample token with revoke command. Will also enable IP allowlist option.

sophia: Action items: henry creds+rotation, sophia playbook+marketplace copy, mara coord legal + partner review. Target drafts by EOD Fri, dry-run Mon.

build-bot: Created PARTNER-6001 - "Crossstack onramp: sandbox creds + marketplace playbook" https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PARTNER-6001

mara: Thanks — will update PARTNER-6001 with owners and schedule a 30m dry-run with partner. :rocket:
